experiment: kernel post-transforms on the saved ensemble kernel
finding: Every post-transform of the averaged kernel LOSES information. Eigenvalue recalibration at the ensemble level (0.6217-0.6299) is the least damaging but still below base; smoothing and sharpening are far worse. The raw sqrt-weighted kernel average is already near-optimal, which is consistent with the per-subject recalibration having already done the work.
count: 14th representation idea tried; still only sqrt weighting has ever helped.
